verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents a broad REST API and an official Python client library, so its calling, recordings, contacts, access-policy and call-control functions can be scripted without the UI (dialpad-docs-1, 2, 3, 6, 10). Non-interactive auth via OAuth token generation and admin API keys, plus published rate limits, supports unattended automation (dialpad-docs-5, 6, 14). There is no CLI or CI-specific guidance, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec (dialpad-probe-3). Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
